subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should PR 97966 be accepted as the canonical fix for issue 97877 despite the server_error live proof gap and the retry/failover merge risk?
rationale: The patch looks correct, but it changes session/message delivery behavior around provider failures and overlaps with other open fix PRs, so maintainers should explicitly choose the canonical branch and accepted proof bar.

options.title: Land this PR after exact-head gates
options.body: Accept the runner-level server_error proof plus live unclassified gateway proof as sufficient and land this as the canonical issue 97877 fix.
